label: Division 296 large super balance threshold (LSBT)
quote: For the 2026–27 income year, the LSBT is $3 million and the VLSBT is $10 million.
notes: The page gives the threshold in millions of dollars, and the pattern reads it with that unit. ITAA 1997 s 296-30, inserted by the Treasury Laws Amendment (Building a Stronger and Fairer Super System) Act 2026 (No. 8, 2026), sets $3,000,000 for the 2026-27 income year and indexes it for later years: https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00008/asmade. The page says the indexation is in $150,000 increments.
